description: This file defines the main activity for an Android dictionary app, handling search queries, displaying results, and managing interactions with search suggestions or list items.

classes.name: SearchableDictionary
classes.description: Main activity class for the searchable dictionary app, manages user interactions, search functionality, and result display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and handles the starting intent.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents when activity is launched in singleTop mode, forwarding to handleIntent.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes search or view actions based on the intent received.

methods.name: showResults
methods.description: Executes the search query, updates UI with results via cursor, and manages item clicks.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu; integrates SearchView if Android version supports it.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles options menu selections, triggers search request if search item is selected.
